end_condition: Rhea halts before accepting the Starter Cache, spotting the hidden terms indicator.

last_scene: Rhea climbed the steep ash slope to the crater's ridge, discovering a glowing Starter Cache pedestal.
The System offered her basic survival provisions, displaying her critical 1 HP and 100,000 Soul Debt.
Just before accepting the desperately needed gear, she noticed a tiny, hidden asterisk attached to the terms.

Rhea spotted a microscopic asterisk next to the 'Accept' button, realizing the offer was a trap.
